name: Arieli
description: Arieli was an Expansion Region planet under the Galactic Empire's rule. After a local insurgency sabotaged the Imperial Arquitens-class light cruiser Peacemaker there, the cruiser began firing on the world's municipal buildings. The light freighter Mighty Oak Apocalypse did a supply run to the planet during the Galactic Civil War.
